source: flutter\_translate keeps plural forms as nested keys. From version 4, the forms are the Intl plural names {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4} and {5}. Before version 4, they were {6}, {7}, {8} and {9}. The preset adds a derived key {10} for each of these forms, so the {11} check does not report the forms of a used key.
text: flutter\_translate 將複數形式保存為巢狀鍵。從版本 4 開始，這些形式為 Intl 複數名稱 {0}、{1}、{2}、{3}、{4} 和 {5}。在版本 4 之前，則為 {6}、{7}、{8} 和 {9}。此預設集會為每個形式新增衍生鍵 {10}，因此 {11} 檢查不會回報已使用鍵的各個形式。
